findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I have reviewed the contract and would like to request one minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms delay payment beyond thirty days and make it conditional upon invoice confirmation. I propose modifying this so that the agreement states: The Client shall pay undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Thank you for your understanding.
